name: Giveon
notes: "The clearest half-time-ballad exemplar in this section." The research gives an unusually hard tempo fact — the catalogue "clusters hard on two values, 118 (D♭ major) for the mid-tempos and 143 (E minor) for the ballads, and the 143 group's snare sits on beat 3, so it is a felt 71.5 half-time" — so the window is authored around those two clusters with the 113–120 group as the floor, and `halfTime` is true. Both home keys are authored and nothing else, because the entry says they recur "to an unusual degree". ⛔ **The 808 is killed:** "a sustained low sine or upright-style bass on the chord root with almost no slides — the low end is harmonic rather than percussive", which is a bass part, not a drone, so `bass808` is null and the `bassline` follows roots with `glideProb` at the floor. The drum block is the most negative-space one in this batch and it is stated: "one deep kick on 1, a single reverbed snare or clap on beat 3, and often no hats at all… This near-absence of hat activity is what distinguishes him from the rest of the lane." The melody's own parameter is named too — "bass-baritone placed unusually low (the register itself is the parameter)" — so the register floor is the lowest in the section. ⚠ The **INFERRED** parameters are the swing amount, every drum probability, and the chord extension spread; "`i–VI–III–VII`, `IMaj7–vi7–ii7–V7`" is the entry's own numeral list, with the sevenths moved into `extensions` because a numeral names a degree here. ⚠ `confidence` is medium — the research rates it high-medium. ⚠ **`drums.kick.lockTo808` removed (2026-08-17, 808 gate).** This kit has no 808 — `bass808` is `null` here or in the parent it inherits — and `lockTo808` is the one parameter that says *how much of the kick the 808 follows*, so in this file it described a pairing that does not exist: `generators::drums::bass808` returns on `block.is_none()` before the value is ever read, which makes it provably dead here. Where it was NOT dead was in the artists and producers who extend this kit and author an 808 of their own: they inherited the zero, `kicks.iter().filter(|_| rng.random_bool(0.0))` kept nothing, and their sub lane was silent at every seed — `bass808::every_shipped_model_with_an_808_produces_a_playable_line` reported "no 808 at all" for 35 of them. Removing it restores the engine's documented default of 1.0 for exactly those children and changes nothing here. ⚠ No researched claim moved: this kit's own statement about the 808 is the `bass808: null` beside it, and that is untouched. ⚠ **The bassline reached 918 of 1,000 distinct against `bass.rs`'s 0.95 share**, over a kick that plays one note a bar. `mirror_kick` and `glideProb` 0.02 stay for *"a sustained low sine or **upright-style bass** on the chord root with almost no slides"* — "almost no slides" is `glideProb`, not `followRootsProb` — and the movement is the upright half of that sentence over harmony the research calls *"genuinely cadential — `i–VI–III–VII`, `IMaj7–vi7–ii7–V7`"*, which is where an upright bass plays approach notes. ⚠ **INFERRED:** `followRootsProb` 0.88, the `M2` beside `P5` and `M3`, and `anticipationProb` 0.22 are lane-conventional rates; the entry marks its drum values folded and inferred already.
